title: [FEATURE] Notebook tool: add append support for write mode
body:
### Problem Statement

The notebook tool's `write` mode requires either `oldStr + newStr` (replacement) or `insertLine + newStr` (insertion). There is no way to simply append text to a notebook without knowing a line number or existing text to match against.

This causes models to fail on their first attempt when trying to write content, since they naturally try `{ mode: 'write', newStr: 'some text' }` without `insertLine` or `oldStr`. The Zod validation rejects it, and the model has to retry with `insertLine` added, costing an extra round trip.

### Proposed Solution

Add support for `write` with just `newStr` to append to the end of the notebook:

```typescript
// In the .refine() validation, also allow newStr-only for append:
const hasAppend = data.newStr !== undefined && data.oldStr === undefined && data.insertLine === undefined
return hasReplacement || hasInsertion || hasAppend

// In handleWrite, add append logic:
if (newStr !== undefined && oldStr === undefined && insertLine === undefined) {
  const separator = notebooks[name] ? '\n' : ''
  notebooks[name] = notebooks[name] + separator + newStr
  return `Appended text to notebook '${name}'`
}
```

Alternatively, add a dedicated `append` mode.

### Use Case

Any agent using the notebook tool for note-taking, task tracking, or documentation accumulation. The most natural interaction is "add this to my notebook," which maps to an append operation. Currently the model has to guess a line number or know existing content to do this.

Repro:

```typescript
import { Agent, BedrockModel } from '@strands-agents/sdk'
import { notebook } from '@strands-agents/sdk/vended-tools/notebook'

const agent = new Agent({
  model: new BedrockModel({ region: 'us-east-1' }),
  tools: [notebook],
  systemPrompt: 'You have a notebook tool. Use it when asked. Be concise.',
})

await agent.invoke('Create a notebook called "todo" with content "buy milk"')
```

The model tries `{ mode: 'write', name: 'todo', newStr: 'buy milk' }`, gets a validation error, then retries with `insertLine` added.

### Alternatives Solutions

- Update the tool description to more clearly communicate that `insertLine` or `oldStr` is required for write mode, reducing model confusion (doesn't fix the missing capability though)
- Default `insertLine` to the last line when only `newStr` is provided (implicit append, but less explicit than a dedicated path)

### Additional Context

Found during bug bash (P3). The model self-corrects on retry, so users get the right outcome, but the extra round trip adds latency and token cost.
